verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO Jó respondeu, dizendo:

verses.original: אָ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם־ עָ֑ם וְ֝עִמָּכֶ֗ם תָּמ֥וּת חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mə·nām kî ’at·tem- ‘ām wə·‘im·mā·ḵem tā·mūṯ ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: Truly then you are the people with whom wisdom itself will die
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, vós sois o povo, e convosco morrerá a sabedoria.

verses.original: גַּם־ לִ֤י לֵבָ֨ב׀ כְּֽמוֹכֶ֗ם לֹא־ נֹפֵ֣ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּ֑ם וְאֶת־ מִי־ אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- lî lê·ḇāḇ kə·mō·w·ḵem lō- nō·p̄êl ’ā·nō·ḵî mik·kem wə·’eṯ- mî- ’ên kə·mōw- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: But I also have a mind . . . I am not inferior to you . . . Who does not know such things as these
verses.literalPt: Também eu tenho entendimento como vós, e não vos sou inferior; e quem não sabe tais coisas como essas?

verses.original: שְׂחֹ֤ק לְרֵעֵ֨הוּ׀ אֶֽהְיֶ֗ה קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: śə·ḥōq lə·rê·‘ê·hū ’eh·yeh qō·rê le·’ĕ·lō·w·ah way·ya·‘ă·nê·hū śə·ḥôq ṣad·dîq tā·mîm
verses.literal: I am a laughingstock to my friends though I called on God and He answered The righteous and upright man is a laughingstock
verses.literalPt: Eu sou motivo de riso para os meus amigos; eu, que invoco a Deus, e ele me responde; o justo e perfeito serve de zombaria.

verses.original: לַפִּ֣יד בּ֭וּז לְעַשְׁתּ֣וּת שַׁאֲנָ֑ן נָ֝כ֗וֹן לְמ֣וֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל׃
verses.transliteration: lap·pîḏ būz lə·‘aš·tūṯ ša·’ă·nān nā·ḵō·wn lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏê rā·ḡel
verses.literal: The one at ease scorns misfortune as the fate . . . of those whose feet are slipping
verses.literalPt: Tocha desprezível é, na opinião do que está descansado, aquele que está pronto a vacilar com os pés.

verses.original: יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ אֹֽהָלִ֨ים׀ לְשֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים וּֽ֭בַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·lā·yū ’ō·hā·lîm lə·šō·ḏə·ḏîm ū·ḇaṭ·ṭu·ḥō·wṯ lə·mar·gî·zê ’êl la·’ă·šer hê·ḇî ’ĕ·lō·w·ah bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: The tents of robbers are safe and those who provoke God are secure those who carry their god in their hands
verses.literalPt: As tendas dos assoladores têm descanso, e os que provocam a Deus estão seguros; nas suas mãos Deus lhes põe tudo.

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל־ נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וְע֥וֹף הַ֝שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְיַגֶּד־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ū·lām šə·’al- nā ḇə·hê·mō·wṯ wə·ṯō·re·kā wə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·yag·geḏ- lāḵ
verses.literal: But ask . . . the animals and they will instruct you ask the birds of the air and they will tell you
verses.literalPt: Mas, pergunta agora às alimárias, e cada uma delas te ensinará; e às aves dos céus, e elas te farão saber;

verses.original: א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw śî·aḥ lā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṯō·re·kā wî·sap·pə·rū lə·ḵā də·ḡê hay·yām
verses.literal: Or speak to the earth and it will teach you let the fish of the sea inform you
verses.literalPt: Ou fala com a terra, e ela te ensinará; até os peixes do mar te contarão.

verses.original: מִ֭י לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע בְּכָל־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֥י יַד־ יְ֝הוָה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: mî lō- yā·ḏa‘ bə·ḵāl ’êl·leh kî yaḏ- Yah·weh ‘ā·śə·ṯāh zōṯ
verses.literal: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this
verses.literalPt: Quem não entende, por todas estas coisas, que a mão do SENHOR fez isto?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל־ חָ֑י וְ֝ר֗וּחַ כָּל־ בְּשַׂר־ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer bə·yā·ḏōw ne·p̄eš kāl- ḥāy wə·rū·aḥ kāl- bə·śar- ’îš
verses.literal: The life of every living thing is in His hand as well as the breath of all mankind . . .
verses.literalPt: Na sua mão está a alma de tudo quanto vive, e o espírito de toda a carne humana.

verses.original: הֲלֹא־ אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ אֹ֣כֶל יִטְעַם־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ’ō·zen mil·lîn tiḇ·ḥān wə·ḥêḵ ’ō·ḵel yiṭ·‘am- lōw
verses.literal: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes its food
verses.literalPt: Porventura o ouvido não provará as palavras, como o paladar prova as comidas?

verses.original: בִּֽישִׁישִׁ֥ים חָכְמָ֑ה וְאֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bî·šî·šîm ḥāḵ·māh wə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: Wisdom is found with the elderly and understanding comes with long life
verses.literalPt: Com os idosos está a sabedoria, e na longevidade o entendimento.

verses.original: עִ֭מּוֹ חָכְמָ֣ה וּגְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im·mōw ḥāḵ·māh ū·ḡə·ḇū·rāh lōw ‘ê·ṣāh ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: Wisdom and strength belong to God counsel and understanding are His
verses.literalPt: Com ele está a sabedoria e a força; conselho e entendimento tem. 14 Eis que ele derruba, e ninguém há que edifique; prende um homem, e ninguém há que o solte.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְלֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל־ אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hên ya·hă·rō·ws wə·lō yib·bā·neh yis·gōr ‘al- ’îš wə·lō yip·pā·ṯê·aḥ
verses.literal: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt the man He imprisons . . . cannot be released
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ וִֽ֝ישַׁלְּחֵ֗ם וְיַ֖הַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hên ya‘·ṣōr bam·ma·yim wə·yi·ḇā·šū wî·šal·lə·ḥêm wə·ya·hap̄·ḵū ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: If He holds back the waters they dry up and if He releases them they overwhelm the land
verses.literalPt: Eis que ele retém as águas, e elas secam; e solta-as, e elas transtornam a terra.

verses.original: עִ֭מּוֹ עֹ֣ז וְתֽוּשִׁיָּ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ שֹׁגֵ֥ג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘im·mōw ‘ōz wə·ṯū·šī·yå̄h lōw šō·ḡêḡ ū·maš·geh
verses.literal: True wisdom and power belong to Him The deceived and the deceiver are His
verses.literalPt: Com ele está a força e a sabedoria; seu é o que erra e o que o faz errar.

verses.original: מוֹלִ֣יךְ יוֹעֲצִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְֽשֹׁפְטִ֥ים יְהוֹלֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·lîḵ yō·w·‘ă·ṣîm šō·w·lāl wə·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm yə·hō·w·lêl
verses.literal: He leads counselors away barefoot and makes fools of judges
verses.literalPt: Aos conselheiros leva despojados, e aos juízes faz desvairar.

verses.original: מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים פִּתֵּ֑חַ וַיֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mū·sar mə·lā·ḵîm pit·tê·aḥ way·ye’·sōr ’ê·zō·wr bə·mā·ṯə·nê·hem
verses.literal: He loosens the bonds placed by kings and fastens a belt around their waists
verses.literalPt: Solta a autoridade dos reis, e ata o cinto aos seus lombos.

verses.original: מוֹלִ֣יךְ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְאֵֽתָנִ֣ים יְסַלֵּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·lîḵ kō·hă·nîm šō·w·lāl wə·’ê·ṯā·nîm yə·sal·lêp̄
verses.literal: He leads priests away barefoot and overthrows the established
verses.literalPt: Aos sacerdotes leva despojados, aos poderosos transtorna.

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר שָׂ֭פָה לְנֶאֱמָנִ֑ים וְטַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים יִקָּֽח׃
verses.transliteration: mê·sîr śā·p̲āh lə·ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm wə·ṭa·‘am zə·qê·nîm yiq·qāḥ
verses.literal: He deprives the trusted of speech and takes away the discernment of elders
verses.literalPt: Aos acreditados tira a fala, e tira o entendimento aos anciãos.

verses.original: שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־ נְדִיבִ֑ים וּמְזִ֖יחַ אֲפִיקִ֣ים רִפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šō·w·p̄êḵ būz ‘al- nə·ḏî·ḇîm ū·mə·zî·aḥ ’ă·p̄î·qîm rip·pāh
verses.literal: He pours out contempt on nobles and disarms . . . the mighty
verses.literalPt: Derrama desprezo sobre os príncipes, e afrouxa o cinto dos fortes.

verses.original: מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵ֖א לָא֣וֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ḡal·leh ‘ă·mu·qō·wṯ min·nî- ḥō·šeḵ way·yō·ṣê lā·’ō·wr ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into light
verses.literalPt: Das trevas descobre coisas profundas, e traz à luz a sombra da morte.

verses.original: מַשְׂגִּ֣יא לַ֭גּוֹיִם וַֽיְאַבְּדֵ֑ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם וַיַּנְחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: maś·gî lag·gō·w·yim way·’ab·bə·ḏêm šō·ṭê·aḥ lag·gō·w·yim way·yan·ḥêm
verses.literal: He makes nations great and destroys them He enlarges nations then disperses them
verses.literalPt: Multiplica as nações e as faz perecer; dispersa as nações, e de novo as reconduz.

verses.original: מֵסִ֗יר לֵ֭ב רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־ דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·sîr lêḇ rā·šê ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yaṯ·‘êm bə·ṯō·hū lō- ḏā·reḵ
verses.literal: He deprives the earth’s leaders of reason and makes them wander in a trackless . . . wasteland
verses.literalPt: Tira o entendimento aos chefes dos povos da terra, e os faz vaguear pelos desertos, sem caminho.

verses.original: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ־ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־ א֑וֹר וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yə·maš·šū- ḥō·šeḵ wə·lō- ’ō·wr way·yaṯ·‘êm kaš·šik·kō·wr
verses.literal: They grope in the darkness without light He makes them stagger like drunkards
verses.literalPt: Nas trevas andam às apalpadelas, sem terem luz, e os faz desatinar como ébrios.
